items.title: Cleaner session list
items.text: The "New Window" chooser now shows only sessions you can actually connect to. Sessions you kill (via `/wt-delete`, closing a pane, or a shell exiting) disappear the moment nothing is attached to them, instead of piling up as dead "exited" rows that survive restarts. Sessions whose process is gone only because the agent restarted still appear as resumable.

items.title: Richer banner tables & separators
items.text: Banner pipe-tables now word-wrap long cell text onto multiple lines instead of truncating, and you can add a full-width horizontal divider with a markdown thematic break (`---`, `***`, or `___`) to separate a title, table, and trailing note.
